Engine integration plan: cast is a MOVE of kind 'cast' in the existing combat move table, so RI-CMB02 commitment machinery handles it. actor.js hitboxActive requires m.hitbox so a cast never makes a weapon hitbox; m.iframes undefined so casting can never grant i-frames. Dodge-cancel needs a kind==='cast' branch in player.js _inputDuringCommitment.

mag-probe.mjs: 19/19 live checks PASS. Cast census exact to the frame for all 5 classes; dual cost frame 1; Focus monotonic over 4200 frames; only roll cancels and only after hard_until; zero i-frames; median residual aim error measured; 201 casts one damage value; ballistics within tolerance; levitation 1.5 Focus/m measured; all three RITUAL aborts refund.

GOTCHA for successors: InputPipeline.queueInputs event frames are RELATIVE to the frame queueInputs was called on (scriptBase). Using H.getFrame()+1 silently schedules the input at 2*frame+1 and it never fires. Cost ~40 min.
